class.name: Core
class.brief_description: Lightweight core services for initializing and configuring GodotItch.

method.name: get_game_id
method.description: Returns the configured itch.io game ID used for API calls. If not set, returns an empty string.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Initializes the GodotItch native module. Returns true on success. Safe to call multiple times; subsequent calls will be ignored once initialized.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns true if Core has been successfully initialized.

method.name: set_game_id
method.description: Sets the itch.io game ID for subsequent API requests. Pass an empty string to clear the value.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Shuts down the GodotItch native module and releases resources. After shutdown, call initialize() again before making further API requests.
